title: Hurmula Zulm Na Kar
body:
HURMULA ZULM NA KAR
KHETI THI RORO KAR
HAR SAMANDAR KI NAZAR
Tera Ye Teer Kaha Aur Ye Besheer kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Phool Ka Hai Phaikar
Maa Ka Armaan Hai Ye
Kunbe Ki Jaan Hai Ye
Sheh Ka Hai Laqt-e-Jigar
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekh Rote Hai Nabi
Hath Malte Hai Ali
Fatima Hai Muztar
Qushk Hai Uska Gala
<<DIVIDER>>
Teer Zalim Naa Chala
Bezaba Hai Asghar
Hichikiya Hain Paiham Aur Hai Chere Pe Varam
Pyaas Ka Hai Ye Asaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Che Mahine Ka Hai Ye Laal
Tashnagi Se Nidhaal
Muztarib Hain Madar
Haye Wo Kaise Jiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Apne Bache ke Liye
Maa Tadapti Hai Udhar
Baal Khole Zehra
Karti Hai Aa-o-Buka
<<DIVIDER>>
Ambiya Hai Muztar
Phool Sa Tha Chera
Aab Hai Murjhaya Huwa
Lag Gayi Kiski Nazar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghar Mei Jhula Dale
Apne Bhai Ke Liye
Muntazir Hai Qawhar
Aisa Hota Hai Kahin
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya Tu Insaan Nahi
Kya Nahi Tujko Qabar
Haye Bhuke Pyase
Kabse Hai Ye Baccha
<<DIVIDER>>
Tashnalab Tashna jigar
Karbala Mei Ahsan
Qatm Tha Ranjo Mahan
Khete The Jin-o-Basha
